stories.title: Road closed near Moel Famau car park due to police incident
stories.summary: A road through the Clwydian Range has been closed by police near the lower Moel Famau car park. Drivers and walkers have been asked to avoid the area and use alternative routes. stories.title: Three rare giant otter pups born at Chester Zoo take their first swimming lessons
stories.summary: Three giant otter pups born at Chester Zoo have had their first swimming lessons, 15 weeks after arriving in February. stories.title: Every NHS Wales waiting time target set in 2022 has been missed. Here is where things stand now.
stories.summary: More than 529,000 people in Wales were waiting for NHS treatment at the end of March 2026, and none of the five recovery targets set four years ago have been met, according to a new analysis by Senedd Research. stories.title: Diocese told Flintshire Catholic school staff not to speak to BBC during filming visit, audit finds
stories.summary: The Catholic Diocese of Wrexham told staff at St Anthony’s Catholic Primary School in Saltney not to speak to a BBC film crew that arrived at the school in March 2025, an internal audit report has revealed. The instruction was sent by email on 11 March 2025 and forwarded to all staff at the school.

stories.title: Chester bridge safety petition relaunched after cyclist killed in hit and run
stories.summary: A petition calling for safety improvements on Hoole Bridge in Chester has been relaunched in memory of cyclist Lee Stallwood, who died on the bridge on 21 May after a collision with a driver who left the scene.
